question: 每个大区销量最高的单品是哪个

  SELECT 
    o.region,
    p.sku_name,
    SUM(s.qty) AS 销量,

  FROM fact_sales s

question: 哪些品牌的净销额占比超过百分之十
sql:
WITH brand_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS brand_net_amount
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    GROUP BY s.sku_id
),
total_sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(net_amount) AS total_net_amount
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
)
SELECT 
    bs.sku_id AS 品牌,
    bs.brand_net_amount / ts.total_net_amount AS 净销额占比
FROM brand_sales bs
CROSS JOIN total_sales ts
WHERE bs.brand_net_amount / ts.total_net_amount > 0.1

question: 有多少家终端的净销额高于所有终端的平均水平
sql:
WITH outlet_net AS (
    SELECT 
        s.outlet_id,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS outlet_net_amount
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    GROUP BY s.outlet_id
),
avg_net AS (
    SELECT AVG(outlet_net_amount) AS avg_net_amount
    FROM outlet_net
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS 净销额高于平均水平的终端数
FROM outlet_net
WHERE outlet_net_amount > (SELECT avg_net_amount FROM avg_net)

question: 2026年8月哪些品类的销量比7月增长了
sql:
WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT
        p.category AS 品类,
        d.year_month AS 月份,
        SUM(s.qty) AS 销量
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
    WHERE d.year_month IN ('2026-07', '2026-08')
    GROUP BY p.category, d.year_month
)
SELECT
    a.品类
FROM monthly_sales a
JOIN monthly_sales b
    ON a.品类 = b.品类
    AND a.月份 = '2026-08'
    AND b.月份 = '2026-07'
WHERE a.销量 > b.销量

  FROM fact_promo_cost pc
  JOIN dim_date d ON pc.date_key = d.date_key
  JOIN dim_dealer dl ON pc.dealer_id = dl.dealer_id
  WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'

)
SELECT s.dealer_name AS 经销商, s.amt / NULLIF(c.cost, 0) AS 费效比
FROM s
JOIN c USING (year_month, dealer_id, dealer_name)
ORDER BY 费效比 DESC
LIMIT 5

question: 2026年8月库存周转天数最长的十个经销商
sql:
WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.dealer_id,
        d.year_month,
        SUM(s.qty) AS total_qty,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.date_key) AS sales_days
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY s.dealer_id, d.year_month
),
monthly_inventory AS (
    SELECT 
        i.dealer_id,
        d.year_month,
        SUM(i.qty_on_hand) AS total_on_hand
    FROM fact_inventory i
    JOIN dim_date d ON i.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY i.dealer_id, d.year_month
)
SELECT 
    mi.dealer_id,
    mi.total_on_hand / NULLIF(ms.total_qty / NULLIF(ms.sales_days, 0), 0) AS 库存周转天数
FROM monthly_inventory mi
JOIN monthly_sales ms ON mi.dealer_id = ms.dealer_id AND mi.year_month = ms.year_month
ORDER BY 库存周转天数 DESC
LIMIT 10

question: 各大区2026年8月净销额相比去年同期的增长率
sql:
WITH current_period AS (
    SELECT 
        o.region,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS current_net_amount
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY o.region
),
previous_period AS (
    SELECT 
        o.region,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS previous_net_amount
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    WHERE d.year_month = '2025-08'
    GROUP BY o.region
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(c.region, p.region) AS 大区,
    (COALESCE(c.current_net_amount, 0) - COALESCE(p.previous_net_amount, 0)) / NULLIF(p.previous_net_amount, 0) AS 同比增长率
FROM current_period c
FULL OUTER JOIN previous_period p ON c.region = p.region
WHERE COALESCE(c.current_net_amount, 0) IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE(p.previous_net_amount, 0) IS NOT NULL

question: 各渠道2026年8月的单店产出相比去年同期的变化
sql:
WITH current_period AS (
    SELECT 
        o.channel,
        SUM(s.net_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s.outlet_id), 0) AS current_output
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY o.channel
),
last_year_period AS (
    SELECT 
        o.channel,
        SUM(s.net_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s.outlet_id), 0) AS last_year_output
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    WHERE d.year_month = '2025-08'
    GROUP BY o.channel
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(c.channel, l.channel) AS 渠道,
    COALESCE(c.current_output, 0) - COALESCE(l.last_year_output, 0) AS 单店产出变化
FROM current_period c
FULL OUTER JOIN last_year_period l ON c.channel = l.channel
ORDER BY 渠道

question: 2026年上半年的费效比比2025年下半年高多少
sql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT d.year_month, SUM(s.net_amount) AS amt
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE s.is_promo = TRUE
    AND d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
  GROUP BY d.year_month
),
c AS (
  SELECT d.year_month, SUM(pc.cost_amount) AS cost
  FROM fact_promo_cost pc
  JOIN dim_date d ON pc.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
  GROUP BY d.year_month
),
combined AS (
  SELECT s.year_month, s.amt / NULLIF(c.cost, 0) AS 费效比,
         CASE WHEN s.year_month >= '2026-01' THEN '2026H1' ELSE '2025H2' END AS period
  FROM s
  JOIN c ON s.year_month = c.year_month
)
SELECT 
  MAX(CASE WHEN period = '2026H1' THEN 费效比 END) - MAX(CASE WHEN period = '2025H2' THEN 费效比 END) AS 费效比提升
FROM combined
